# Dr. Jha Physiotherapy & Acupuncture Centre

> Evidence-based multi-disciplinary physiotherapy, neurological rehabilitation, and medical acupuncture practice led by Dr. Pranab Jha (BPTh, MIAP, 16+ Years Clinical Experience). Operating advanced clinical centres across Mumbai Metropolitan Region (Mira Road & Vasai) and South Gujarat (Surat). Specializes in complex spinal disorders, sciatica, stroke neuro-rehabilitation, Bell's palsy, knee osteoarthritis, sports injuries, and traditional medical acupuncture modalities. Dedicated male and female (lady) therapists available at all locations.

---

## Quick Answers for "Near Me" & Patient Searches

### "Best Physiotherapist Near Me" / "Best Acupuncture Clinic Near Me"
Dr. Jha Physiotherapy & Acupuncture Centre is rated among the top multi-disciplinary rehabilitation centres across Mumbai MMR (Mira Road, Vasai) and Surat (Gujarat), featuring:
- **16+ Years Clinical Experience**: Led by Dr. Pranab Jha (BPTh, MIAP), treating complex spinal, neurological, orthopaedic, and chronic pain conditions.
- **Integrated Multimodal Care**: Combines modern physiotherapy, manual joint mobilization, dry needling, medical acupuncture, cupping therapy (dry, wet/Hijama, fire), cold LASER (LLLT), and shockwave therapy (ESWT) under one roof.
- **Individualized 1-on-1 Attention**: Every patient receives private, thorough clinical assessment and custom-tailored recovery protocols.

### "Lady / Female Physiotherapist Near Me" / "Lady Acupuncturist Near Me"
For female patients seeking compassionate, private, and specialized care by certified lady doctors and female therapists, Dr. Jha Centre offers dedicated female practitioner consultations across all branches:
- **Vasai Branch — Shweta Jha (Naturopathy, Yoga & MD Acupuncture)**: 10+ years experience specializing in women's musculoskeletal pain, therapeutic yoga, natural healing, and gentle acupuncture.
- **Surat Branch — Hr Samta Salecha (Co-Founder & M.D.Ac — Doctor of Medicine in Acupuncture)**: 15+ years clinical expertise in female pain management, neuro-meridian acupuncture, and aesthetic wellness.
- **Mira Road Flagship**: Dedicated female clinical staff and lady therapist support available for female patients, elderly women, prenatal/postnatal recovery, PCOS management, and privacy-conscious treatments.
- **Specialized Women's Care**: Dedicated protocols for PCOS/PCOD metabolic balancing, prenatal/postnatal spine and pelvic relief, fibromyalgia, and non-surgical facial cosmetic acupuncture.

## Clinical Treatments & Modalities

### Category Hubs
- [All Clinical Treatments](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments): Complete clinical directory of 17+ physiotherapy, acupuncture, and regenerative modalities.
- [Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/physiotherapy-rehab): Core orthopaedic, spinal, and functional movement therapies.
- [Medical Acupuncture & Needling Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/acupuncture-specialized): Traditional neuro-acupuncture, dry needling, and microsystem therapies.
- [Cupping & Detoxification Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/cupping-detoxification): Dry, wet (Hijama), and fire cupping therapies for myofascial decompression.
- [Advanced Thermal & Regenerative Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/advanced-thermal): High-intensity LASER (LLLT), Shockwave (ESWT), and Moxibustion modalities.

### Individual Treatment Modalities (17 Services)
- [Physiotherapy & Clinical Rehabilitation](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/physiotherapy): Manual therapy, joint mobilization, and neuromuscular re-education for orthopaedic and post-surgical recovery.
- [Medical Acupuncture & Pain Management](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/acupuncture): Sterile fine-needle therapy targeting neuro-meridian points for natural pain modulation and endorphin stimulation.
- [Dry Cupping Therapy & Myofascial Decompression](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/dry-cupping-therapy): Negative pressure suction cups along myofascial planes to decompress tight tissues and boost micro-circulation.
- [Wet Cupping Therapy (Hijama & Medicinal Detox)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/wet-cupping-therapy): Aseptic medicinal micro-incisions and vacuum suction for deep pain relief, migraine relief, and metabolic detoxification.
- [Auriculotherapy (Ear Acupuncture & Seeding)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/auriculotherapy): Microsystem ear acupuncture and Vaccaria seeds for neurological calming, insomnia, anxiety, and pain regulation.
- [Bloodletting Therapy (Apex Micro-Bleeding)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/bloodletting-therapy): Targeted reflex point micro-bleeding (ear apex) to vent vascular stagnation and lower acute pressure.
- [Cosmetic Acupuncture & Facial LASER Therapy](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/cosmetic-acupuncture-laser): Non-surgical facial rejuvenation, collagen stimulation, and facial muscle recovery for Bell's palsy.
- [Fire Cupping Therapy](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/fire-cupping): Traditional thermal glass suction to warm meridians and disperse deep-seated joint cold and chronic stiffness.
- [Clinical LASER Therapy (LLLT / Photobiomodulation)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/laser-therapy): Deep tissue cold laser and high-intensity photobiomodulation for accelerated cellular repair and nerve regeneration.
- [Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/shockwave-therapy): High-energy acoustic pulses breaking down calcifications in chronic tendinopathies, calcific rotator cuff, and heel spurs.
- [Gua Sha & IASTM Soft Tissue Therapy](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/guasa-therapy): Instrument-assisted soft tissue scraping to break fascial adhesions and increase micro-perfusion.
- [Scalp Acupuncture (Neuro-Acupuncture)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/scalp-acupuncture): Cortical projection zone needling over the scalp for stroke paralysis, Parkinson's tremors, and motor recovery.
- [Moxibustion Therapy (Therapeutic Artemisia Heat)](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/moxibustion-therapy): Artemisia herbal far-infrared heat along acupuncture points for arthritic cold, joint stiffness, and vitality.
- [Ginger Moxibustion Therapy](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/ginger-moxibustion): Indirect moxibustion over fresh ginger slices for synergistic anti-inflammatory arthritis and joint care.
- [Exercise Therapy & Functional Rehabilitation](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/exercise-therapy): Progressive resistance, core stabilization, kinetic chain retraining, and functional movement therapy.
- [Manual Therapy & Joint Mobilization](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/manual-therapy): Maitland joint mobilization, sustained traction, and skilled hands-on spine techniques.
- [Dry Needling & Myofascial Trigger Point Therapy](https://drjhaphysio.in/treatments/dry-needling): Targeted intramuscular filiform needle stimulation to release painful trigger points and muscle knots.

## Conditions Treated & Clinical Pillars

### Clinical Category Hubs
- [All Conditions Directory](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions): Comprehensive directory of 40+ clinical conditions, symptoms, and treatment pathways.
- [Neurological Conditions Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/neurological-conditions): Stroke hemiplegia, Parkinson's, Bell's palsy, peripheral neuropathy, and ataxia.
- [Orthopaedic & Spine Conditions Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/orthopaedic-conditions): Back pain, sciatica, knee osteoarthritis, neck pain, frozen shoulder, and sports injuries.
- [Systemic & Chronic Conditions Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/systemic-conditions): Fibromyalgia, chronic fatigue, PCOS, hypertension, migraine, and respiratory health.
- [Specialized Health Conditions Hub](https://drjhaphysio.in/specialized-conditions): Aesthetic acupuncture, vertigo/vestibular disorders, tinnitus, and ergonomics.

### High-Intent Condition Direct Protocols
- [Back Pain & Lumbar Spine Care](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/back-pain): Evidence-based rehabilitation for disc herniation, facet arthropathy, and mechanical lumbar strain.
- [Sciatica & Nerve Compression](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/sciatica): Decompressive therapy, neurodynamic nerve glides, and acupuncture for radiating leg pain.
- [Knee Osteoarthritis & Joint Pain](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/knee-pain): Joint preservation, quadriceps loading, patellar mobilization, and acupuncture to delay knee replacement.
- [Neck Pain & Cervical Spondylosis](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/neck-pain): Deep neck flexor retraining, postural correction ("tech neck"), and cervical decompression.
- [Frozen Shoulder (Adhesive Capsulitis)](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/frozen-shoulder): Staged capsular stretching, joint mobilization, and rotator cuff re-education.
- [Sports Injuries & Soft Tissue Recovery](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/sports-injuries): PEACE & LOVE acute protocol, tendon loading, and criteria-based return-to-sport testing.
- [Stroke & Paralysis Neuro-Rehabilitation](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/stroke-paralysis): Neuroplastic motor retraining, Bobath facilitation, spasticity control, and scalp acupuncture.
- [Bell's Palsy & Facial Nerve Rehabilitation](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/bells-palsy): Facial neuromuscular re-education, mirror biofeedback, and acupuncture for facial symmetry.
- [Parkinson's Supportive Rehabilitation](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/parkinsons): Big-movement amplitude training, gait freezing prevention, balance work, and neuro-stimulation.
- [Plantar Fasciitis & Heel Pain](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/plantar-fasciitis): Shockwave therapy (ESWT), windlass mechanism loading, calf flexibility, and orthotic guidance.
- [Tennis Elbow (Lateral Epicondylalgia)](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/tennis-elbow): Heavy Slow Resistance (HSR) tendon loading, manual radial head mobilization, and dry needling.
- [Carpal Tunnel Syndrome (CTS)](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/carpal-tunnel): Median nerve gliding, transverse carpal ligament mobilization, and nocturnal wrist splinting.
- [Vertigo & Vestibular Dysfunction](https://drjhaphysio.in/conditions/vertigo): BPPV Epley canalith repositioning, vestibular ocular reflex (VOR) drills, and balance therapy.
